description:
Use this when the user asks how an Indian stock's PE, PB (price-to-book, banks included), price-to-sales or market cap has changed over time.

Returns a series of P/E, P/B, price to sales, market cap and net debt, and for non-financial companies the enterprise-value multiples. Each point uses that day's close and only the results that were public by then. `days` (1 to 1825, default 365) counts back from today; `interval` is "daily", "weekly" or "monthly". P/B is given for banks, NBFCs and insurers; their enterprise-value fields are empty.

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, e.g. TCS, INE467B01029 or 532540. Always send it as `query` (not `symbol`).
